name: create_feedback_report
description: Generate and save a private report from all selected current-run source evidence. With source evidence this starts budgeted background LLM reading and synthesis, validates complete coverage and persists HTML before READY. The host waits on PENDING; do not poll. Legacy evidence_id accepts an already-completed analyze_feedback asset; never mix legacy and source references.

evidence_id.description: Completed current-run feedback evidence returned by analyze_feedback, not a pending operation ID or old-run evidence.

comment_evidence_id.description: Required when COMMENT is selected: current-run analyze_comments source evidence.

danmaku_evidence_id.description: Required when DANMAKU is selected: current-run analyze_danmaku source evidence.
